principles.statement: REG aliases represent one business identity while REG_FILE remains distinct.
ORDER aliases represent one business identity; PO similarity is not sufficient authority.
Composite key is valid only when every mandatory component is nonempty and non-null.
Planned purchase cannot enter actual purchase totals or supply actual valuation rate.
Unknown monetary amount is not zero.
Currency mixing without explicit conversion and provenance is prohibited.
Conflicting same-grain rates are withheld; file row order is not selection policy.
Nonfinite numeric values cannot enter financial KPIs or coverage.
Physical source file/sheet/row lineage survives canonical transformation.
Missing-stage gap requires an applicability contract; absence of evidence alone is not proof of mandatory missing stage.
Transport/customs/clearance evidence alone does not automatically prove discharge of FX commitment.
Shared role across sources is a join candidate, not proof of authoritative comparability.
Material is not required for NTSW registration/allocation/commitment gate.
